claim: Of E3M1's 67 user channels (100 and over), 29 reach doors and motion (21 z-motion, 6 slide, 2 rotate), 18 reach destruction set pieces (kTrapExploder 459 on 13, kThingObjectExplode 417 on 5), 13 reach switches and 15 reach staged sound and spawns (kGenSound 6, kSoundPlayer 4, 710 on 2, kMarkerDudeSpawn 3); a channel may reach several kinds. DWE3M1 spends 58, with kSoundPlayer on 22. By these two towns, a town that wires only doors is under-wired.
